# OpenTechJobs.org

> An open-source tech job board focused on Israel. It pulls listings straight from the hiring systems of about 3,450 companies (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday and others) every 5 minutes, so a listing here is the employer's own posting, not a repost. The same companies' roles in other countries are listed too. The data is free to use through a public JSON API with no key.

Every listing links to the employer's own application page. Salaries come in three kinds, and the API says which one you are looking at in `salary_source`: `disclosed` is the employer's published range, `table` is our estimate for the role and seniority in the Israeli market, and `estimated` is our estimate from what comparable roles pay at that company and location. Only `disclosed` comes from the employer.

## Pages

- [Job board](https://opentechjobs.org/): search and filter open listings, with live hiring statistics for the current search.
- [Explore](https://opentechjobs.org/stats): query every tracked listing with filters and groupings, or with SQL, in the browser.
- [API reference](https://opentechjobs.org/api/help): every public endpoint and parameter.
- [Privacy policy](https://opentechjobs.org/privacy): what the optional alerts feature stores.
- [Source code](https://github.com/guyvolvo/opentechjobs): MIT licensed.

## API

All endpoints below are public, free and need no key. Responses are JSON.

- [GET /api/jobs](https://opentechjobs.org/api/jobs?country=IL&search=devops&limit=20): open listings. `search` takes up to 10 words that must all appear ("quote a phrase" to keep it together). `country` takes ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes, comma-separated (`IL,DE`). `city` takes city names, comma-separated. `company` takes company domains. `department`, `seniority` and `workplace` (`remote`, `hybrid`, `onsite`) narrow further. `skills` takes a comma-separated skill list, and with `sort=match` ranks listings by how many of those skills they mention. Other `sort` values are `age` (default), `company`, `title`, `location` and `ats`. `limit` is 1 to 500, `offset` pages through.
- [GET /api/jobs/{id}](https://opentechjobs.org/api/help): one listing, with its full description.
- [GET /api/companies](https://opentechjobs.org/api/companies): every tracked company and the hiring system it uses.
- [GET /api/stats](https://opentechjobs.org/api/stats): board-wide numbers, including open roles, new and closed listings, top hiring companies, categories and seniority.
- [GET /api/facets](https://opentechjobs.org/api/facets): the filter values that currently have listings, including countries and their cities.
- [GET /api/health](https://opentechjobs.org/api/health): how fresh the data is.

## Optional

- [GET /api/pipeline-status](https://opentechjobs.org/api/pipeline-status): scraper pipeline state.
- /api/me/alerts: saved searches that email new matches. Requires signing in.
